history.sg_progress: Umoja workflows will be reviewed and revised, wherever possible without customization, to allow decision makers to make approvals directly in Umoja. Where it is not viable to integrate the decision-making steps into Umoja, the Administration will reinforce the documentation of such decisions and require the attachment of the relevant documentation from such transactions, in order to implement the decisions in Umoja. The Administration is looking into strengthening an existing software solution to make it a standard document management system. With regard to decisions for which the approval can neither be made in Umoja nor documented in Umoja at the stage of implementation, the Administration will look into implementing an alternative solution to create workflows allowing the documenting and tracking of all steps of the decision-making process from the approval to the implementation stages.

history.administration_response: The Administration started discussions with the Umoja team to identify those processes where existing capabilities could be leveraged or easily enhanced to capture the information on decision-making. For other decisions, the Secretariat is conducting a comprehensive exercise to prepare a common catalogue of services across all administrative functional areas. Working groups have been created in the different functional areas, and intensive work has led to the preparation of draft catalogues.
